Definition: from G577; cast off, i.e. (figuratively) such as to be rejected:--be refused.
BiblicalUsage: Once, about food. Every creature of God is good, and nothing to be refused, if it be received with thanksgiving — nothing God made is cast off as unclean once grace and gratitude have received it.
TheologicalSignificance: The word exists to be denied: in Christ, nothing God created is to be thrown away.
